project_name: Apex Medical Directory Follow-up Scope Review

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Hi Sarah, thanks for meeting again. After reviewing the initial scope with our clinic board, we have a few critical scope adjustments.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Sure Dr. Vance, let's walk through what changed.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: First, our board decided that nobody uses fax machines anymore. Please remove the legacy Fax Number directory filter entirely.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Instead, we desperately need Geolocation Radius Search powered by Google Maps so patients can find doctors within 15 miles of their home address.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Because of clinic budget approvals, we need to shift the target completion date from November 15th to December 1st, 2026.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Brenda Vance
dialogue.text: Oh, and one more thing: can your team also build native iOS and Android apps for the Apple App Store and Google Play within this same contract?

dialogue.speaker: Sarah Jenkins
dialogue.text: Native App Store builds represent an entirely separate multi-platform mobile development initiative. We will flag that as an Out-of-Scope item and provide an optional separate estimate.
